configurations.//: Attach-only (url, no command): connects to the `composer dev` server already on :8000 instead of racing it for the port. The port is NOT interchangeable, so autoPort must stay off — APP_URL is pinned to http://localhost:8000 and every asset('storage/...') URL the player loads is absolute against it, so a reassigned port would break lesson media and session cookies.
configurations.name: serve

configurations.//: Standalone globe-layer harness: esbuild bundle plus the baked ocean fields, no Laravel involved. Exists because the ocean layer cannot be judged from a screenshot — it is measured with gl.readPixels from inside a render pass.
configurations.name: ocean-harness
